features: PIMS project setup lists every case study grouped under its demonstration area: Tuscan Archipelago; Iceland, Greenland, Faroe Islands (Arctic Northeast Atlantic); Azores, Madeira, Canary Islands (Macaronesia) (1.34.1).
Getting Started answer options (roles, tasks, basic needs, activity sectors, risks, knowledge topics) are translated in all 9 languages.

Dropdown and checkbox options that were written in English in the code are translated (Kumu export, validation steps, BOT element types, loop effect and strength, CLD polarity, strength, confidence, layout and direction, network metrics, report types, AI assistant step title).
German: 79 buttons and labels lowercase the verb ('Daten exportieren', 'Projekt speichern').

medium: Standard Entry (ISA): Back/Next did nothing in languages other than English (1.34.0).
Getting Started checkboxes flickered and lost ticks (1.33.0).
Loop analysis: the strength and distribution plots were always blank; long element names were cut off (1.33.0).
AI assistant: a swapped connection whose reverse is not a DAPSIWRM link is now left out with a message, instead of being stored in the wrong direction (1.33.0).
Register tenet levels are validated: values outside the allowed levels, and 'intermediate' on any tenet other than ecological effectiveness, are cleared on load (1.32.1).
Workshop participants with duplicate ids in a hand-edited file are renumbered instead of being deleted together (1.32.1).
Workshop apply records survive removing a measure from the workshop, so Undo still works after the measure is put back (1.32.1).
Adding a second stakeholder, engagement, communication or response measure created duplicate rows (since 1.16.5).
Scenario Builder impact analysis crashed on scenarios that remove a link.
Added links failed to bind to baseline edges that carry extra columns.
performance: ML connection suggestions: batch graph-feature extraction computes paths, neighbours and centrality once per call instead of per pair; 2000 pairs on a 200-node network went from 35 s to 0.2 s with identical output (1.26.1).
high: Connection review (AI assistant, templates, import): approving a connection rebuilt every tab and card list, so the review jumped between sections; approving now updates only that card, the counts and the tab badge (1.34.1).
Export Data: the downloaded file contained none of the ticked components (labels and values were swapped); checkboxes now show translated names and the export includes them (1.34.0).
AI-assistant template models had no links in the diagram (connections saved under legacy matrix names); fixed, and older template projects are repaired when opened (1.33.0).
AI assistant: Save did nothing after the automatic save, so later approvals and edits never reached the project (1.33.0).
Scenario Builder: creating a scenario on a project with links ended the session (1.33.0).
Changing the user level reloaded the page and cleared the project; the project is now kept across the reload (1.33.0).
Feedback page showed no feedback once any entry had been marked addressed (an empty field was saved as {} instead of null); the loader now tolerates it and the markers keep null (1.32.4).
Auto-save backups wrote empty fields without null, so recovery could drop a whole element category; the loader now binds rows by key union, so older backups recover too (WS-4).
low: Tooltips on the connection review raised a JavaScript error on every update (Bootstrap 4 has no Tooltip.getInstance) (1.34.1).
Workshop export: tenet point columns read '1 = Completely disagree' ... '5 = Completely agree'; Lithuanian 'Label' header corrected (1.32.3).
Workshop and readiness xlsx files: column headers and labels in the user's language; the answers sheets keep their code headers so they can still be imported (1.32.2).
Response register title corrected in German, Lithuanian, Norwegian and Greek (1.32.2).
Workshop participants with an unknown entry source show an empty source instead of a missing-label code (1.32.2).
Workshop page: translated yes/no and 'n' labels; no space before colons; the import refusal names the file's own column headers (1.32.1).

migration_notes: Projects that use a WP5 indicator are stamped min_app_version 1.24.0; 1.23.0 and older would drop the indicator columns on save.

Projects with an intervention-designer scenario that re-weights links (links_modified) are stamped min_app_version 1.28.0; 1.27.0 and older would ignore the re-weights and show the scenario as unchanged.
Projects with stakeholders saved by 1.30.0 (or with Policy_Target) need app 1.30.0; older apps cannot add stakeholders to the 14-column register.
Projects with readiness answers need app 1.31.0.
